data_intake.description: Writes logs, metrics, traces, and other data, and reports deployments and changes.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.empty_description: Invite a teammate to grant access to this organization.
invitations.completed_reason: An accepted invitation cannot be resent.
invitations.not_pending_reason: Only pending invitations can be revoked.

email_domains.title: Email domains
email_domains.subtitle: Restrict which email domains can join this organization via invitation or SSO. Empty = no restriction.
email_domains.empty_description: Add a domain to require members' email addresses to match it. While empty, any email may join.
